description: Add path-based route aliases in the backend YueduApi.kt so the compiled frontend's URL patterns (/reader3/file/*, /reader3/httpTTS/*, /reader3/book/saveBookConfig, /reader3/user/downloadBackupFile) work alongside the existing flat routes.
steps: Step 1: Add file management path-based aliases in YueduApi.kt initRouter(). After the existing flat file routes (around line 400), add path-based aliases that map to the same controller methods: router.get('/reader3/file/list').coroutineHandler { fileController.list(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/list').coroutineHandler { fileController.list(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/upload').coroutineHandler { fileController.upload(it) }, router.get('/reader3/file/download').coroutineHandlerWithoutRes { fileController.download(it) }, router.get('/reader3/file/get').coroutineHandler { fileController.get(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/get').coroutineHandler { fileController.get(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/save').coroutineHandler { fileController.save(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/mkdir').coroutineHandler { fileController.mkdir(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/delete').coroutineHandler { fileController.delete(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/deleteMulti').coroutineHandler { fileController.deleteMulti(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/importPreview').coroutineHandler { fileController.importPreview(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/restore').coroutineHandler { fileController.restore(it) }, router.post('/reader3/file/parse').coroutineHandler { fileController.parse(it) }

Step 2: Add HttpTTS path-based aliases: router.get('/reader3/httpTTS/list').coroutineHandler { httpTTSController.getHttpTTSList(it) }, router.post('/reader3/httpTTS/save').coroutineHandler { httpTTSController.saveHttpTTS(it) }, router.post('/reader3/httpTTS/saveMulti').coroutineHandler { httpTTSController.saveHttpTTSList(it) }, router.post('/reader3/httpTTS/deleteMulti').coroutineHandler { httpTTSController.deleteHttpTTS(it) }

Step 3: Add book path-based alias (if not already existing): router.post('/reader3/book/saveBookConfig').coroutineHandler { bookController.saveBookConfig(it) }. Also add: router.get('/reader3/user/downloadBackupFile').coroutineHandlerWithoutRes { userController.downloadBackupFile(it) }. Verify /reader3/book/tts already exists (it does at line 417-418).
acceptance_criteria: Backend compiles successfully with ./gradlew compileKotlin compileJava -x test
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/reader-dev && ./gradlew compileKotlin compileJava -x test and verify BUILD SUCCESSFUL
findings: All route aliases added successfully. Build passes with no errors (only pre-existing warnings). /reader3/book/tts was already present (lines 417-418) so no duplicate was added. The /reader3/saveBookConfig flat route already existed at line 235 - the new /reader3/book/saveBookConfig is the path-based alias. The /reader3/downloadBackupFile flat route existed at line 434 - the new /reader3/user/downloadBackupFile is the path-based alias.
